item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00180","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C21","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C14 plausibly supplied a material drafting template because it uses the same distinctive three-stage administrative sequence as the child: delegation of presidential statutory authority to the Secretary of the Interior, authorization for the Secretary to redelegate that authority to specified subordinate officers, and authorization for the Secretary to prescribe implementing procedures. C21 has a similar delegation–redelegation–regulations structure, but involves a different department and a much broader regulatory program. C03 shares Interior redelegation language but only as an amendment to an existing order and lacks the child's full operative sequence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby delegated to the Secretary of the Interior... the authority vested in the President by section 45(a) of the Alaska Omnibus Act","parent_excerpt":"I hereby delegate to the Secretary of the Interior the authority vested in the President by section 1 of the act of June 25, 1910","explanation":"Both provisions use materially parallel language to transfer specifically identified presidential statutory authority to the Secretary of the Interior."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Interior is hereby authorized to redelegate to... all or any part of the authority delegated to the Secretary of the Interior by section 2 hereof.","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Interior is authorized to redelegated the authority delegated to him by this order to one or more of the following-designated officers","explanation":"Both expressly authorize redelegation of the newly delegated authority to enumerated Interior Department subordinates."},{"child_excerpt":"All transfers and conveyances made under or pursuant to this order shall be made in accordance with such policies, conditions, and procedures as may be prescribed by the Secretary of the Interior.","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Interior is authorized to issue such rules and regulations, and to prescribe such procedures, as he may from time to time deem necessary or desirable for the exercise of the authority delegated to him by this order.","explanation":"Both conclude the delegation machinery by empowering the Secretary to prescribe procedures governing exercise of the authority."}]}
